title: The Postcards of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Felix Oyelaran
blurb: Theo Sterling, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
